description.value: Moutcha Bay Resort is a remote oceanfront fishing resort on the shores of Nootka Sound, roughly two hours by road from Campbell River through Strathcona Park and the village of Gold River. It offers a range of accommodation from two-storey lodge suites and luxury cedar yurts to waterfront chalets and 24-site RV and tent camping with full hook-ups. An on-site licensed restaurant (Conuma Grill), a full-service marina with boat rentals, kayak and paddleboard hire, and guided fishing round out the experience on Vancouver Island's wild west coast.
